news.title: The 15-Minute Battery: Inside Base Power's Austin Factory

bullets: Own and improve critical parts of Base’s acquisition, activation, and retention funnel: from first touch through long-term engagement.
Identify and execute large strategic bets that materially improve growth performance, scalability, or customer experience.
Build new growth products and systems from scratch, including self-serve flows, onboarding experiences, lifecycle products, referral systems, internal tooling, and funnel…
Partner closely with engineering, design, analytics, operations, and growth teams to ship high-quality customer experiences quickly.
Define and improve product measurement: instrumentation, events, funnels, experimentation frameworks, attribution hygiene, and operational reporting.
